annotations.title: Corner trim on your saw: mitre, bevel, stops and the gap

description: Cuts one corner of skirting, casing or crown molding on a named saw: per piece the mitre and bevel as its dials read, the stop each sits on, how the piece lies, which side to keep, whether the saw can make it; cope or mitre, and the gap a 45° cut leaves. No sizing.

buildUp.description: Plaster or compound built up in the corner (it changes the angle the trim meets). Left out, none.

corner.description: The corner as measured. For casing, the frame corner (90 for a square opening); its kind is ignored.

angle.description: θ, the angle the two faces include: the room's side inside, the solid's side outside; 90 is square.

customSaw.description: With saw custom: the saw's own limits.

crossCutMm.description: The blade's reach across the table at a square cut, mm (20 to 1200).

maxBevelLeft.description: Degrees, 0 to 60 (0: it does not tilt that way).

uprightMm.description: The tallest piece stood against the fence, mm (10 to 400).

depth.description: The depth the joint runs across in the plane of the turn: a skirting's thickness, a casing's face width, a crown's projection. Left out: 18 mm, 70 mm or 75 mm (3/4, 2 3/4 or 3 in).

detail.description: full (the default): the whole answer. summary: the result lines, the citation line and the page only — fewer tokens to read.

feather.description: The distance that build-up is feathered over along each wall. Left out, 150 mm (6 in).

height.description: Skirting only: its height, for the saw's upright capacity. Left out, 120 mm (4 3/4 in).

inputUnits.description: Send "base" to pass bare numbers on dimensioned inputs in base units (m, m², L, kg …), as the published test vectors are written. Without it a length, area or volume must carry its unit.

method.description: How the piece goes on the saw: skirting and casing upright (against the fence) or flat (on the table); crown nested (upside down against the fence) or flat. Left out, the trim's usual one.

saw.description: The saw from the site's library (each with its scale, its stops and its capacity); custom with customSaw. Left out, the 12-in double-bevel slider (DWS779 figures).

spring.description: Crown only: its spring angle from the wall, degrees (38 for 38/52, 45 for 45/45). Left out, 38.

system.description: The unit system inputs left out open in, and the one the page link opens in. The answer comes in both.

throughRoom.description: In place of corner: the angle read through the room (under 180 inside, over 180 outside), as the miter-angle calculator takes it.

trim.description: skirting (baseboard), casing (architrave, a frame corner) or crown (cornice).

name: trim_corner

effectiveAngle.description: After any build-up: the angle the trim actually meets.

correctedGap.description: The joint the corrected cut leaves: closed by construction.

text.description: In the system asked for, then the other.

open.description: The miter page's corner tool, opened on this corner and these settings.

degrees.description: Off square (mitre) or off vertical (bevel), magnitude.

dial.description: What the saw's own scale reads.

stop.description: The stop it sits on (null: between stops), the nearest stop on the saw's dial and how far off, degrees.

keep.description: The side of the blade the piece to keep lies on.

degrees.description: Off square (mitre) or off vertical (bevel), magnitude.

dial.description: What the saw's own scale reads.

stop.description: The stop it sits on (null: between stops), the nearest stop on the saw's dial and how far off, degrees.

plainMitre.description: The swing off square each of the two pieces needs, 90 − θ/2, degrees.

standardGap.description: The joint a 45° cut (the "square corner" setting) leaves on this corner.

text.description: In the system asked for, then the other.

citation.description: The one citation line, built from the answer's own data.

lines.description: The result lines, as the report's table gives them.

notes.description: What a professional must decide, when to call one, a false-friend warning, that adoption is local: kept in every summary.
